title: 卷一江湖少年 第三章此事不得外传卷一江湖少年 第四章这东西碰不得
slug: 梦启东梁第一四零六章蛛丝有毒

此事，不得外传。
小渔船上，小书童在船上拉，沧叔和少年在水中托举着，好不容易将这人弄到了船上，本就不大的小渔船中间躺了一个人，空间显得更加紧凑了。
“沧叔，你快看下还有没有救？“顾不得自己衣衫湿透，少年在一旁催促道。
沧叔也不多言，直接俯下身伸手在昏迷之人的鼻端探了探，又附耳在胸口听了听，之后才将双手按在这人的胸口，一顿一顿的按压了起来。
“咳~咳咳~“
在少年与书童焦急的等待中，小船内忽然传来了一阵急促的咳嗽声。
小乞丐隋缘感觉自己做了一个很可怕的噩梦，梦里自己从不知道多深的断崖上跳下来后就来到了一个漆黑的屋子里，任凭自己如何的大喊大叫，周围都是黑漆漆的一片，一点动静都没有。
就在自己绝望的快要放弃的时候，忽然感觉黑暗中有一丝光亮透了进来，还没等他反应过来，隋缘忽然感觉自己的喉咙就像是被人拿着锉刀在来回锉一样，火烧火燎的疼了起来。
隋缘心中的第一反应就是自己被长刀门的人抓住了，现在的感觉是长刀门的人在对自己用刑了。
想到张山那张令人讨厌的大黑脸，隋缘忍不住骂了一句“狗日的”
，随后脑袋一歪，再次昏了过去。
“。
。”
小船上，沧叔与少年三人不由得愣了愣，刚才隋缘的声音虽然小，但却也足够三人听得清楚了。
“这人真是不知好歹，”
一旁的书童反应过来，有些不忿的说到，“咱们好心救了他，他居然还骂我们，咱们就应该直接把他丢到海里喂王八。”
“好了，小松，”
少年反应过来，向一旁的沧叔说到，“他应该是还没有回过神来，所以才会如此口不择言，沧叔，你先将他带到船舱里去吧，咱们这就回去。”
“是，少爷。”

沧叔闻言应了声，俯身抱起隋缘进了船舱，没多久，小船开始缓缓的向着平川城的方向驶去。
“废物，都是废物。”
另一边，长刀门内，面色阴沉的赵如安看着面前的在赵二与张山两人，满身的怒气使得大厅内外的人都绷紧了神经，唯恐自己一个不慎引得门主的怒火发泄在自己身上。
另一边，赵如安的两个儿子，长子赵飞，次子赵康也都站在大厅两侧，想到那个不知所踪的小乞丐，面上神色同样阴郁。
“父亲，”
看着气愤的来回走动的赵如安，赵康沉声道，“现在那小乞丐带着秘图消失了，咱们当下之急是尽快想办法弥补，不然五音亭二长老那里怪罪下来，咱们可无法抵挡啊！”
“如何弥补？”
一旁的赵飞闻言沉声道，“这秘图是李长老指定索要的聘礼，其他东西少了还好说，这秘图丢了，我们难道去哪里再找一张吗？”
“再找一张！
？”
正在气愤中的赵如安闻言蓦然冷静了下来，思量了片刻，轻声开口道，“你们说那五音亭的李长老，有没有见过那张秘图是什么样的？”
声音传出，大厅内陡然安静了下来。
父子三人相视一眼，彼此明白了赵如安的意思。
“这么做，万一被那五音亭的人识破了怎么办？”
赵康的话语中有些担忧，“毕竟我们都清楚，这张图说是李长老指定的聘礼，但实际上却是五音亭里面的授意的，万一出了纰漏，”
赵康后面的话没有说完，但一旁的赵飞和赵如安两人却都明白这其中的凶险。
“没有了这份聘礼，五音亭那里我们也不好交待。”
赵飞沉声道。

This matter must not be spread externally.
On the small fishing boat, the little book boy was pulling him on the boat. Uncle Cang and the boy were lifting him in the water. They finally got the man onto the boat. There was a person lying in the middle of the small fishing boat, which made the space even more compact.
"Uncle Cang, please check and see if there is any hope of help?" The young man urged from the side, regardless of whether his clothes were soaked.
Uncle Cang didn't say much. He leaned down and reached out to touch the unconscious man's nose. He put his ear to the chest and listened. Then he put his hands on the man's chest and started to press it.
"Cough~cough~"
While the boy and the book boy were waiting anxiously, a rapid cough suddenly came from inside the boat.
The little beggar Sui Yuan felt that he had a terrible nightmare. In the dream, he jumped from a cliff at an unknown depth and came to a dark room. No matter how much he yelled, the surroundings were pitch black and there was no movement at all.
Just when he was about to give up in despair, he suddenly felt a ray of light coming through the darkness. Before he could react, Sui Yuan suddenly felt as if his throat was being filed back and forth with a file, and it started to hurt.
Sui Yuan's first reaction was that he had been caught by the people from the Changdao Clan, and now he felt that the people from the Changdao Clan were torturing him.
Thinking of Zhang Shan's disgusting black face, Sui Yuan couldn't help but cursed "shit"
, then his head tilted and he fainted again.
".
. "
On the boat, Uncle Cang and the young man could not help but be stunned. Although Sui Yuan's voice just now was low, it was enough for the three of them to hear clearly.
"This guy is really ungrateful,"
The bookboy on the side reacted and said angrily, "We rescued him with kindness, but he still scolded us. We should just throw him into the sea and feed him to the bastard."
"Okay, Xiaosong,"
The young man reacted and said to Uncle Cang, "He probably hasn't come to his senses yet, that's why he spoke so rudely. Uncle Cang, please take him to the cabin first, and we'll go back right away."
"Yes, Master."
Uncle Cang responded when he heard the words, leaned over and picked up Sui Yuan and entered the cabin. Not long after, the boat began to sail slowly towards Pingchuan City.
"Trash, it's all trash."
On the other side, inside the Changdao Gate, the gloomy-looking Zhao Ruan looked at Zhao Er and Zhang Shan in front of him. The anger in his body made everyone inside and outside the hall tense up, fearing that he might accidentally cause the door owner's anger to be vented on him.
On the other side, Zhao Ruan's two sons, the eldest son Zhao Fei and the second son Zhao Kang, were also standing on both sides of the hall. Thinking of the missing little beggar, their faces looked equally gloomy.
"Father,"
Looking at Zhao Ru'an walking back and forth angrily, Zhao Kang said in a deep voice, "Now that little beggar has disappeared with the secret map, our immediate priority is to find a way to make up for it as soon as possible, otherwise the second elder of Wuyinting will blame him, and we will not be able to resist it!"
"How to make up for it?"
Zhao Fei on the side heard the words and said in a deep voice, "This secret map is the betrothal gift requested by Elder Li. It's okay if there are few other things. This secret map is lost, where should we go to find another one?"
"Find another one!
? "
Zhao Ruan, who was in anger, suddenly calmed down after hearing this, thought for a moment, and said softly, "Do you think Elder Li from Wuyinting has seen what the secret map looks like?"
The sound came out, and the hall suddenly became quiet.
The father and son looked at each other and understood what Zhao Ruan meant.
"If you do this, what if the people from Wuyin Pavilion find out?"
There was some worry in Zhao Kang's words, "After all, we all know that this picture is said to be the betrothal gift designated by Elder Li, but it is actually the one authorized by the people in Wuyin Pavilion. If something goes wrong,"
Zhao Kang didn't finish what he said, but Zhao Fei andHowever, both Zhao Ruan and Zhao understood the danger involved.
"Without this betrothal gift, it will be difficult for us to deal with Wuyinting."
Zhao Fei said in a deep voice.
